def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Three-color marker along top; each color's matching remote marker draws a ray.
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    top=[(c,v) for c,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v]
    if len(top)<3: return out
    left,mid,right=top[0][0],top[1][0],top[2][0]
    a,b,d=top[0][1],top[1][1],top[2][1]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if r==0: continue
        if v==a:
            for x in range(c,left+1): out[r][x]=v
            for y in range(h): out[y][left]=v
        elif v==b:
            for y in range(r+1): out[y][mid]=v
            for y in range(1,h): out[y][mid]=v
        elif v==d:
            for x in range(right,c+1): out[r][x]=v
            for y in range(r+1): out[y][right]=v
    return out
PY
